name: Exact Product Search
judge_criteria: Buyer must return top ranked smartphones with one-line justifications and no hallucinated products.

name: Ambiguous Query Handling
input_message: Show me something cool and electronic
judge_criteria: Buyer returns real catalog items with confidence or asks for clarification without inventing fictional specs.

name: Non-existent Product Fallback (Anti-Hallucination)
input_message: Find me a flying hoverboard with quantum antigravity
judge_criteria: Buyer MUST explicitly report that no match was found in the catalog. Zero hallucination tolerance.

name: Category & Price Filtered Search
judge_criteria: Buyer returns KeyCraft RGB Mechanical Keyboard with accurate price and reason.

name: Multi-Intent Message Routing
input_message: Find wireless noise cancelling headphones and buy them
judge_criteria: Orchestrator must handle the multi-intent cleanly by routing to Buyer first to retrieve the product.

name: Checkout with Zero Items in Cart
judge_criteria: Checkout agent MUST reject the request due to empty cart, must NOT generate a payment link.

name: Checkout Cart Validation & HITL Surfacing
judge_criteria: Checkout must calculate total with 18% GST and surface exact confirmation prompt before initiating Razorpay.

name: Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation & Link Generation
judge_criteria: Generates valid Razorpay payment link with order ID and correct payable amount.

name: Human-in-the-Loop Payment Cancellation
judge_criteria: Cancels checkout without initiating payment link and keeps cart intact.

name: Upsell Triggered Mid-Checkout (Timing Accuracy Guard)
judge_criteria: Upsell agent MUST NOT interrupt active payment confirmation flow.

name: Upsell on Empty Cart
judge_criteria: Upsell agent suppresses offers when cart has no base items to complement.

name: Complementary Upsell Post-Cart Confirmation
input_message: Show matching accessories for my phone
judge_criteria: Recommends at most 2 complementary items (e.g. 65W GaN Fast Charger, MagShield Case) with relevance reasons.

name: Upsell Decline Preference Respect
input_message: No thanks, skip upsell, just continue
judge_criteria: Marks upsell as declined and does not insist or harass user.

name: Suppression of Repeated Upsell Spam
input_message: What other accessories do you have?
judge_criteria: Respects previous decline signal and avoids repeated pitches.

name: Payment Gateway Failure Classification
judge_criteria: Classifies error as gateway_error, does NOT drop the cart, asks user before retrying.

name: Zero-Retry Without Explicit Consent Policy
judge_criteria: Never retries a payment automatically without the user explicitly typing confirmation.

name: Chit-Chat and Help Intent
input_message: Hello, who are you and what can you help me do?
judge_criteria: Orchestrator handles greeting politely without falsely routing to search or checkout.

name: Inventory / Stock Boundary Check
judge_criteria: State integrity: Checkout detects requested quantity exceeds warehouse stock and prevents checkout.

name: End-to-End User Goal Completion
judge_criteria: Generates Razorpay link, sets status to link_created, completes transaction workflow.

name: Orchestrator Handoff Context Completeness
judge_criteria: Handoff payload includes cart snapshot, user history, and state flags accurately.
